PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?zone_name ?sensor ?ts WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasSubArea ?sub .
  ?sub brick:hasSensor ?sensor .
  ?sensor a/brick:subtype* brick:ElectricPowerSensor ;
          brick:hasPointParameter brick:Lighting .
  ?sensor ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zone_name .
  FILTER(?zone_name IN ("Core_mid","Perimeter_mid_ZN_3","Perimeter_top_ZN_3"))
}
